name: MEV bot 0xd61492 router unauthenticated command entry
summary: The bot's vault 0xd614927a executes commands from its whitelisted router 0x8db0efee, whose entry 0x0582f20f runs a caller-supplied command program, including DELEGATECALL to caller-chosen code, for any caller. The attacker had the vault flash-borrow from a fake Aave-style pool, which used the vault's repayment approvals to pull all its tokens.
notes: The vault granted the router its command role (role 2) in 0x998b1cef, nine minutes after the router was deployed. The exploit needed that grant, so it sets the age (rule 8); both contracts are otherwise unchanged and unverified.
Earlier vault calls come from the operator's other router 0x08bc5144 and pay the operator; they are normal use, not exploits.
